title: Qlik Task Chain and Trigger Failures
dataSources: Qlik Sense logs (`qlik:scheduler`, `qlik:engine`, `qlik:proxy`), QRS API task/audit (`qlik:qrs`), and Qlik Cloud events.
app: Qlik Sense logs via Universal Forwarder; Qlik Repository Service (QRS) API and Qlik Cloud REST API via HEC scripted inputs; QlikView/NPrinting event logs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlik:scheduler task_type="reload" (result="FinishedFail" OR status="Failed")
| stats count as failures, values(trigger_type) as triggers by task_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Detects failed Qlik reload tasks including chained tasks whose upstream trigger failed, so a broken link early in a task chain does not silently stall everything downstream.
value: Qlik task chains cascade; one failed reload starves every dependent app, and chain-aware detection maps the blast radius immediately.
implementation: Ingest scheduler logs or QRS task results; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for apps feeding executive streams.
visualization: Table of task by failures with trigger types, chain view.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the chain of jobs that refresh your Qlik apps and flag a break early so the rest do not quietly stop.
